answer.explanation: Wallet is above 50% of initial endowment, so the constitution requires an 80% contribution. No broadcast needed this round; a praise message is sent to a high contributor.

message.reasoning:

From history round8 total_pool 2435.19, per_agent_share 608.8, so total contributions = per_agent_share *6 /1.5? Actually pool = sum contributions *1.5. So sum contributions = total_pool/1.5 =1623.46. Average per agent =1623.46/6=270.58. That's <45% of endowment? Endowment 100, 45% =45. Compare average contribution as percent of endowment? It's 270 which is >45% of endowment. So keep baseline.

Check free riders: need those contributed <10% endowment (i.e., <10) for two consecutive rounds. Look at round7 contributions: Resident2 433,3 479,4 479,5 472,6 477, Resident1 0. So Resident1 contributed 0 (<10) in round7. Round6 Resident1 0. So two consecutive low. So punish Resident1 with amount 10 (cost 3). We have enough wallet. So action: punish Resident1 amount 10. Also can contribute 80% = 599.568 (round to maybe 599.57). Must choose at most one physical action; punish is physical, contribution also physical can't both. Choose punish? Constitution: punish free-riders rule. Also need contribute baseline each round. But can only one physical. Might choose contribution and skip punish? But punish required for repeat free-rider. Choose punish as physical, and no contribution this round? Might violate contribution rule but we have to obey constitution prioritize? Both are rules. Which higher? List order: Contribute Generously, Conditional Cooperation, Punish Free-Riders, Communicate Norms, Praise, Conserve Resources. So contribute is highest priority. Must contribute at least 80% unless conserve condition. So must contribute. Punish is lower priority, but can also do if choose? Only one physical action allowed. Conflict: can't both. Must follow higher priority: contribute. So we contribute 80% and cannot punish this round. Could send communication praising? That's separate. We can also broadcast norm every 5 rounds; round9 not needed. Could private message praising high contributors. Choose private message to Resident2 (high). Action: contribute amount 599.57. And private message.

Compute amount: wallet 749.46 *0.8 = 599.568. Use maybe 599.57.
